# Job Chapter 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 426r–426v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/JOB_028_page_001.jpg, JOB_028_page_002.jpg

---

**28:1** "For there-is a-mine [motsa] for-silver [la-kesef], and-a-place [maqom] for-gold [la-zahav] [where] they-refine [yazoqqu] [it].

**28:2** Iron [barzel] from-the-dust [me-afar] is-taken [yuqqach], and-stone [even] [one] pours-out [yatsuq] copper [nechusah].

**28:3** An-end [qets] he-sets [sam] to-the-darkness [la-choshekh], and-to-every limit [takhlit] he searches-out [hu choqer] — the-stone [even] of-darkness [ofel] and-deep-darkness [tsalmavet].

**28:4** He-breaks-open [parats] a-shaft [nachal] from [me'im] the-sojourner [gar]; [those] forgotten [ha-nishkachim] by-the-foot [mi-ragel] — they-hang [dallu], far-from-men [me-enosh] they-sway [na'u].

**28:5** The-earth [erets] — from-it comes-forth [yetse] bread [lachem]; and-beneath-it [vetachteha] it-is-overturned [nehpak] as-by-fire [kemo esh].

**28:6** The-place of-sapphire [sappir] [are] its-stones [avaneha], and-dust of-gold [afrot zahav] [is] in-it.

**28:7** The-path [nativ] — no bird-of-prey [ayit] knows-it [yeda'o], and-the-eye of-the-falcon [ayyah] has-not-caught-sight-of-it [shezafat'hu].

**28:8** The-proud-beasts [benei shachats] have-not-trodden-it [lo hidrikushu]; the-lion [shachal] has-not-passed [adah] over-it.

**28:9** Upon the-flint [challamish] he-stretches-out [shillach] his-hand [yado]; he-overturns [hafakh] mountains [harim] from-the-root [mi-shoresh].

**28:10** In-the-rocks [ba-tsurot] he-cuts [bi'ea] channels [ye'orim]; and-every precious-thing [yaqar] his-eye [eino] sees [ra'atah].

**28:11** From-weeping [mi-beki] [of the] rivers [neharot] he-dams [chibesh]; and-the-hidden-thing [ta'alumah] he-brings-out [yotsi] to-the-light [or].

**28:12** But-wisdom [ha-chokmah] — from-where [me'ayin] is-it-found [timmatse]? And-where [ve'eizeh] [is] the-place [maqom] of-understanding [binah]?

**28:13** Man [enosh] does-not know [lo yada] its-arrangement [erkah]; and-it-is-not found [lo timmatse] in-the-land of-the-living [erets ha-chayyim].

**28:14** The-deep [tehom] says [amar], 'It-is-not in-me [lo vi hi]'; and-the-sea [yam] says, 'It-is-not with-me [ein immadi].'

**28:15** Fine-gold [segor] cannot-be-given [lo yuttan] in-exchange-for-it [tachteha], and-silver [kesef] cannot-be-weighed-out [lo yishakel] as-its-price [mechiraha].

**28:16** It-cannot-be-valued [lo tesulleh] with-the-gold of-Ophir [be-ketem Ofir], with-precious [yaqar] onyx [shoham] or-sapphire [sappir].

**28:17** Gold [zahav] and-glass [uzkhuhit] cannot-compare [lo ya'arkenah]; nor-[can it be] exchanged [temuratah] for-vessels [keli] of-fine-gold [paz].

**28:18** Coral [ra'mot] and-crystal [gavish] shall-not-be-mentioned [lo yizzaker]; and-the-possession of-wisdom [meshekh chokmah] [is] above rubies [mi-peninim].

**28:19** The-topaz [pitdat] of-Cush cannot-compare [lo ya'arkenah]; with-pure gold [be-ketem tahor] it-cannot-be-valued [lo tesulleh].

**28:20** And-wisdom [ha-chokmah] — from-where [me'ayin] does-it-come [tavo]? And-where [ve'eizeh] [is] the-place [maqom] of-understanding [binah]?

**28:21** It-is-hidden [ne'elmah] from-the-eyes of-all living [kol chai], and-from-the-birds of-the-heavens [of ha-shamayim] it-is-concealed [nistarah].

**28:22** Abaddon [avaddon] and-Death [mavet] say [amru], 'With-our-ears [be-oznenu] we-have-heard [shamanu] its-report [shim'ah].'

**28:23** God [Elohim] understands [hevin] its-way [darkah], and-he knows [yada] its-place [meqomah].

**28:24** For he looks [yabbit] to-the-ends of-the-earth [qetsot ha-arets]; under all the-heavens [ha-shamayim] he-sees [yir'eh].

**28:25** To-make [la'asot] a-weight [mishqal] for-the-wind [la-ruach], and-the-waters [mayim] he-measured [tikken] by-measure [be-middah].

**28:26** When-he-made [ba'asoto] a-decree [choq] for-the-rain [la-matar], and-a-way [derekh] for-the-thunder-bolt [la-chaziz qolot] —

**28:27** then he-saw-it [ra'ah] and-declared-it [yesapperah]; he-established-it [hekhinha] and-also searched-it-out [chaqarah].

**28:28** And-he-said to-man [la-adam], 'Behold, the-fear of-the-Lord [yir'at Adonai] — that [is] wisdom [chokmah]; and-to-turn-away [sur] from-evil [me-ra] [is] understanding [binah].'"

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "a mine for silver":** The chapter opens with an extended metaphor of mining — humanity can dig deep into the earth to find precious metals, but wisdom remains beyond reach.

**v.12 — The refrain:** "But wisdom — from where is it found?" This question (repeated in v.20) is the structural and theological hinge of the poem. Human ingenuity can find gold, sapphire, and iron — but not wisdom.

**v.22 — "Abaddon and Death say":** Even the personified forces of destruction have only heard a *rumor* of wisdom. The underworld possesses less wisdom than God.

**v.28 — "the fear of the Lord":** Hebrew *yir'at Adonai* — the only verse where *Adonai* (the Lord) appears rather than *El*, *Eloah*, or *Shaddai*. This unique divine name usage may indicate an editorial addition, or it may be deliberate: the poem's climax invokes the covenant God. The conclusion echoes Proverbs 1:7 and 9:10.

*— EMET*
